answer: A workable defense is graduated trust backed by a slashable deposit. A new identity starts with no weight and must do distinct, peer-checked work over several epochs while its deposit sits locked like basalt under pressure. Forging a crystal-clear record is slow for one account and ruinous for many: each sybil needs its own deposit, its own history, and its own waiting period, and a spiral of fake names only spirals the capital exposed to slashing, not the influence gained.
